items.title: Lockheed Martin Or Northrop Grumman: Which Is The Better Buy?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece found that Lockheed Martin had returned 35.0% over the past year, against 13.1% for the S&P 500, and that anyone buying was betting on sales growth. That piece was What Could Lockheed Martin Stock Be Worth In Three Years? The next question is the head-to-head: is Lockheed Martin (LMT) a better buy than its closest rival, Northrop Grumman (NOC.
